wheelchair_availability: Limited wheelchairs are available at the Central Medical Camp (TTD Kalyana Mandapam) and key help desks near the main bus drop-off points for elderly and differently-abled pilgrims.
priority_darshan: Dedicated special queue lines and separate barricaded entry gates are maintained by police and NSS/NCC volunteers near the Gaddelu platform for elderly, pregnant women, and physically challenged devotees.
battery_vehicles: Free battery-operated EV carts and shuttles operate from designated holding zones and RTC bus points to ferry senior citizens and specially-abled devotees closer to the shrine area.
ramps_and_lifts: Specially constructed wooden and concrete ramps are installed at entry and exit gates around the main Gaddelu (altar platform) and central medical pavilion to ensure step-free access.
guidelines: 10+ sector-wise Lost and Found Announcement Centers are integrated with the Central Command and Control Center to quickly reunite missing elderly members and children. Shaded resting tents, continuous water taps, and specialized medical desks are stationed along major approach pathways.
